name: Ivan Fiore
original_name: イヴァン・フィオーレ
source:
Accomplished for his young age, Ivan is the newest addition to the CR-5 that is aiming to become its leader. As a result, he is completely against Gian possibly becoming the next leader. There are members that don't trust him simply because Ivan isn't Italian (he's supposedly an Irish-American).  His blunt, direct, foul-mouthed and plain rude attitude doesn't help his relations with his fellow members, and he isn't well-liked.

[spoiler]Usually, Ivan is aggressive and domineering towards those weaker than him. Even so, he is easily picked on by Gian. Due to an incident in the past, he has an acute mistrust of most he meets. As a result, he is self-sufficient and highly independent. He adores his Mercedes Benz. Ivan's favorite color is white, and his favorite foods are hotdogs and lollipops. His hobby is driving. Ivan's CR-5 tattoo is located on his right shoulder.[/Spoiler]

[Source: [URL=http://www.tennenouji.net/product/03_luckydog1/charactor/index.html]Luckydog 1 official website[/URL].]
